title: Research and Markets: Oil & Gas Monthly Deals Analysis - Q3, 2012: M&A and Investment Trends
主要内容: Research and Markets has announced the addition of GlobalData's new report titled "Oil & Gas Monthly Deals Analysis - Q3, 2012: M&A and Investment Trends" to their offering. The report provides detailed information on mergers and acquisitions (M&As), equity/debt offerings, private equity, venture financing, and partnership transactions in the oil and gas industry during August 2012. It also includes comparative data on the number of deals and their value over the last six months, subdivided by deal types, segments, and geographies. The report covers key financial advisory firms such as Morgan Stanley, Credit Suisse, and Goldman Sachs. It aims to enhance decision-making capabilities, identify growth segments, and evaluate investment opportunities in the oil and gas industry. The report is available at http://www.researchandmarkets.com/research/p2nl9c/oil_and_gas.
